6.344 rsNestedAggregateInGroupVariable
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsNestedAggregateInGroupVariable is a critical error that will occur when an aggregate function
located in a Group.Variables expression refers to another aggregate function in its Expression
parameter.
